_note: Patterns (case-insensitive) for what a recording replaces outright, with no value shown, and everything a denied function calls with it. `files` are the files of this app's own credential stores: every function in one has its arguments, result and calls hidden, whatever it is called (a store's `set(key, value)` carries a token under no name). `functions` are tested against the function's name split into lowercase words ('getAuthToken' becomes 'get auth token'), so 'tokenize' is not a credential but 'getAuthToken' is. Everything not matched is shown, with secrets that match a pattern in logging/redact.cjs hidden.
